meta.description: Turn your idea into a business model with calculated numbers: a structured diagnostic, a report with a clear verdict, and an AI mentor.

footer.disclaimer: A planning tool, not legal or financial advice.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed, or the page may have been removed.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This page could not be shown. Everything you saved is safe. Try again, or come back in a few minutes.

aboutYou.countryHint: We use it to pick the country data for your analysis. You can change it later.
aboutYou.project: Do you have a project or a project idea?
aboutYou.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
aboutYou.crossborder: I agree that the answers I type are sent to Anthropic in the United States, to check and rewrite them and, later, to run the AI mentor. Email addresses, phone numbers, profile and chat links, bank account (IBAN) and ID numbers, and the name on my Google account are removed first. (Optional)
aboutYou.crossborderHint: Without this consent the whole platform works with its fixed checks, except the AI review and the AI mentor. Names you type yourself are sent as written, so describe people by their role. You can change your mind at any time on your account page.
aboutYou.termsRequired: An account cannot be created without accepting the terms of use.
aboutYou.closedTitle: The platform is not available in your country yet
aboutYou.closedBody: We will open sign-ups in your country soon.
aboutYou.nothingStored: We have not kept any information about you.
aboutYou.accountDeleted: We deleted the account created when you signed in and kept no information about you.

auth.signupLead: Three short steps: two questions about you, your email, then the code we send you. No passwords.
auth.loginLead: We email you an 8-digit code. No passwords.
auth.emailHint: We use it only to send your sign-in code.
auth.codeSent: We sent an 8-digit code to <email>{address}</email>. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.codeSentLogin: If <email>{address}</email> has an account with us, an 8-digit code will arrive within a minute. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.changeEmail: Use another email or request a new code

errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the eight digits or request a new code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.failed: We could not complete that. Please try again shortly.
errors.signupExpired: Your sign-up timed out. Please answer the two declarations again.
errors.google: Signing in with Google did not complete. Try again or use your email.
errors.answers: Some answers are missing. Complete them to continue.

onboarding.title: Complete your account
onboarding.lead: Before you start, complete your details. If this step is not completed within 24 hours, the account is deleted automatically.

projects.title: My projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Start your first one, then answer the diagnostic questions in order.
projects.limit: The free plan allows one project. To start another, delete the current one from its page, or wait for paid plans to open.
projects.newLead: A working name is enough. The country and currency set the data for the analysis and cannot change once you start.
projects.name: Project name
projects.countryHint: The country you will operate in.
projects.currencyHint: The currency you will price and pay in. We always ask and never guess it.
projects.full: Full: 64 questions plus follow-ups, 60 to 90 minutes
projects.failed: The project could not be created. Please try again.

diagnostic.consentOutdated: The consent text for the AI review has changed, so your typed answers get the fixed checks only until you renew your consent on <account>your account page</account>.
diagnostic.dontKnow: I don’t know (saved as an assumption)
diagnostic.savedUnknown: Your current answer is “I don’t know”, saved as a low-confidence assumption. Answer now if you know.
diagnostic.unreadable: Write amounts and percentages as numbers only, such as 250.
diagnostic.confirmTitle: Did we understand your answer as you meant it?
diagnostic.confirmNote: We will save your answer in Modern Standard Arabic and keep what you typed as written.
diagnostic.error: Could not save. Your answer is still here: please try again.
diagnostic.stale: This question no longer applies to your project, so this answer was not saved. Your other answers are safe.
diagnostic.gone: This project no longer exists (perhaps it was deleted in another window), so this answer was not saved.

leave.title: Leave without saving your answer?
leave.body: Your answer to this question is not saved yet. If you leave this page now, what you typed will be lost.

errors.minItems: {count, plural, one {Add at least one item.} other {Add at least # items.}}
errors.outOfRange: The number is outside the accepted range.
errors.url: The link is not valid. Write it in full, such as https://example.com
errors.min_above_max: The lower bound is above the upper one.
errors.percent_total: The shares must add up to 100%.

widgets.label: Item
widgets.name: Name
widgets.individual: If your customer is a person
widgets.organisation: If your customer is a business or body

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.full: Full report: from {threshold}%, with the price and costs.

overview.quickDone: You have answered every quick-version question. Switch to the full version for a deeper report.
overview.nextLead: Answering these raises completeness the most.
overview.tasksLead: Assumptions and missing information that become part of the 30-day validation plan.
overview.toFullLead: 64 questions plus follow-ups. Your current answers stay as they are.
overview.toQuickLead: 20 core questions. None of your answers is deleted.
overview.deleteLead: Deletes the project and all its answers for good.
overview.deleteBody: The project and all its answers will be deleted at once and cannot be recovered.

account.title: My account
account.languageHint: The language of the interface and of our emails.
account.crossborderTitle: AI review and processing outside your country
account.crossborderScope: With this consent, the answers you type are sent to Anthropic in the United States, to check and rewrite them and, later, to run the AI mentor. Email addresses, phone numbers, profile and chat links, bank account (IBAN) and ID numbers, and the name on your Google account are removed first; names you type yourself are sent as written.
account.crossborderOff: Your consent is off: the AI review and the AI mentor are off, and the rest of the platform works fully with its fixed checks.
account.crossborderOutdated: The consent text has changed: you agreed to an earlier text that named only the AI mentor. Until you renew your consent for the text above, your typed answers get the fixed checks only.
account.deleteBody: Deletes your account and everything linked to it, at once and for good.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Your account and all your data will be deleted at once and cannot be recovered.

goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted
goodbye.body: We deleted your account and everything linked to it. You are welcome back at any time.

legal.draftNotice: This text is a draft awaiting legal review and will change before public launch.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.stopPhrase: Not viable in its current form
verdict.stopChanges: These three changes would change the verdict:

assumption.note: This number is an assumption. Test it before you base a decision on it.
